name: Flight delay
wortlaut: If a flight is delayed, all its tasks move by the same time.
wortlautDeutsch: Wenn ein Flug sich verspätet, verschieben sich alle seine Aufträge um dieselbe Zeit mit.
kurz: If a flight reports a delay, its block times and all its tasks move back by the same time; the assignments stay, and new overlaps appear in the conflict counter.
